verdict.rationale: Xero documents public APIs with official OpenAPI descriptions, and its official SDK is described as giving access to general ledger accounting data, so the core of programmatic ledger access is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows a trial balance report endpoint or a complete general ledger extract, and output formats are only implied by the OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an evidenced trial balance API, evidence of full general ledger (journal-level) extraction, documented open export formats such as JSON or CSV for these reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: The xero-node SDK makes it easy for developers to access Xero's APIs in their JavaScript code, and build robust applications and software using small business & general ledger accounting data.
An OpenAPI (Swagger) specification for the Xero API with OAuth 2.0 security schema.
This includes Xero APIs, SDKs, code samples, documentation and more.
